column2: description (written from in-game frames, 2026-11-25; the same scene for every character)
The winner uppercuts the opponent off the stone bridge. They fall down the deep shaft and land impaled on a spike at the bottom, among old corpses.

The winner uppercuts the opponent into the pool of acid. They surface as their skin peels away down to muscle and bone, then sink, leaving only a ribcage floating.
The winner kicks the opponent into the mouth of a living tree, which chews them up, legs last, until only blood runs down its trunk.
The winner bends the opponent over the platform edge and holds their face against a passing train, grinding it along the cars in a shower of sparks and blood, then hurls the body away.
The winner throws the opponent down on the bridge. As they get up on their hands and knees, headlights blind them and a speeding car smashes into their head, leaving the body sprawled on the road.
The winner forces the opponent down at the edge of the lava and pushes their head into it until it burns away.
